systems.name: Peoples Bus Service
systems.operator: Sindh Mass Transit Authority (Transport & Mass Transit Dept, Govt of Sindh); operated by NRTC
systems.payment: Cash to on-board conductor; contactless Sindh Mass Transit card (Zindigi/Mastercard open-loop, automated fare collection launched May 2024, initially on Model Colony-Tower and Gulshan-e-Hadeed-Tower, rolled out in phases). Breeze (BRT) card not documented for PBS.

fare_rules.concessions: Children under 3 free (rehbar.pk). No student concession confirmed (rehbar.pk says none; INCPak claims student/senior discounts). Before 1 Feb 2025: Rs 50 minimum (up to about Rs 100). The same slab is reported for red, EV and double-decker buses (INCPak; Dawn Dec 2025 for double-decker). No further change found up to Sep 2026.

hours.notes: Think Transportation/redbus.shop/rehbar.pk: 07:00-22:00, headway about 15 min in peaks (08-10, 17-20) and 30 min off-peak. INCPak says 07:00-20:00; Wikipedia (2022) 08:00-20:00. Not confirmed by SMTA.

open_questions: No official stop-level ordered lists: SMTA gives abbreviated 'via' lists; order merged with Think Transportation (Feb 2025) and OSM positions on reference polylines. Mid-route orders flagged in notes are unverified.
R14 (Gulshan-e-Maymar - Tower, EV, from 17 Mar 2026): code 'Route 14' only from the SMTA directory; single-source stop list; no reference geometry.
R12 northern terminal Memon Goth (SMTA, ProPakistani 2024) vs Naddi Kinara (Think Transportation); reference polyline does not appear to reach Memon Goth.
R2 terminal Indus Hospital vs Korangi Crossing; R11 terminal Ziauddin Hospital vs Shireen Jinnah Colony; R4 downtown alignment (M.A. Jinnah Road vs Sindh High Court).
Whether pink buses on R1/R2/R3/R9/R10 run all day or only at peaks; pink fare Rs 50 vs 80/120.
Abdullah Chowk - Numaish pink route (Nov 2025): Abdullah Chowk location, intermediate stops, and whether it still runs (absent from SMTA directory).
Operating hours 07:00-22:00 (route-info sites) vs 07:00-20:00 (INCPak); no official 2026 timetable or headways.
Student/senior concessions contradictory (rehbar.pk: none; INCPak: available).
SMTA directory lists R5 (Surjani - Masroor), R6 (Gulshan-e-Bihar - Singer Chowrangi) and R7 (Mosamiyat - Gulshan-e-Ghazi) as Inactive; excluded.
Planned 500 EV buses for new Karachi routes (Ittehad Town, Banaras, Liaquatabad, Orangi etc., 2026 announcements); no launched routes confirmed besides R14.
Double-decker propulsion, headway and exact first stop ('Model Colony Pathak'); EV-5 current fare.
